scope: Same-capture diagnostic only: all slices originate in one previously captured SmolLM request, historically labeled TEST. Token ranges are disjoint, but share a causal context and are not independent prompts or held-out model validation. Synthetic TRAIN/DEV/TEST labels apply only to this diagnostic. Only the three TRAIN ranges fit fresh dictionaries; DEV is reserved and unused; all selected candidates/settings are frozen before fitting, with TEST used only for exact record reconstruction and size analysis. Native tensor execution on CPU establishes functionality and measured byte sizes, never GPU throughput. No fresh forward pass, live-prefill timing, attention, concurrency, capacity gain or full cache container is measured. Raw KV is never saved in the output. Stateful recipes charge their full decoder state once per candidate cache. The portfolio analysis is a size-only oracle over already encoded stateless packets; it is not an implemented online prefill selector.

stateless_size_oracle.scope: SIZE-ONLY oracle over packets that were all separately encoded. One byte per record for the selected mode plus specified cache header/index costs. No packet repacking or online selector exists here; selection compute, mode dispatch latency, encoder work, and attention benefit are not measured. This is not an implemented prefill policy or a latency result.
stateless_size_oracle.accounting: Selected actual inner record bytes + 1 mode byte per record + 32-byte cache header + 8*(record_count+1) offset bytes; no external decoder state.
